method.closure_unit: Every relevant ordinary-declaration site in every declared source file, including a record for helpers or arms that yield no distinct seed.
method.completion_rule: For each source, traverse the declared locator; record every relevant site; assign every site a disposition; close every required topic with a four-observer vector; and include, import, or exclude every reached helper dependency.
method.provisional_identity_policy: SITE.* values are source-provenance identities and SEED.* values are provisional grouping keys only. Neither is a stable semantic catalog ID; Milestone 5 must decide stable identities and preserve merge/split decisions.
method.normativity_policy: All source sites are DISCOVERY or IMPLEMENTATION_OBSERVATION inputs. Agreement, official rejection, mutation evidence, and this grouping do not establish a normative obligation.
